text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Did I see that girl somewhere during the 
Classic year? So she's running today, huh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS was great. I hope she 
does her best today too~.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(More and more people are starting to know 
who I am.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh, no way, they looked over here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I couldn't help overhearing. It 
just made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I hope today becomes even just a tiny 
fragment of your cherished memories.

Amidst silent screams echoing in a corner 
of the paddock— the curtain rose on the 
Yayoi Sho!
